name: video
title: Video
description: A video as a static, PDF-safe poster that links to the clip, written in inline code on a line of its own: `@video{"https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ", title="The 90-second tour", poster=sample:photo-pano.jpg}`. The address comes from the author's own record and nowhere else: nothing here reads a slide's text or its rendered page, so a plugin's drawing can never become a video address. The `video` slide class lays the figure out.
